results.snippet:
KARACHI, Oct 18:  At least 18 workers were abducted, and another was injured after unidentified armed men attacked a marble mining site in Pakistan's restive Balochistan province on Sunday, police said.

The incident took place in the remote Naal area of Khuzdar district when armed men riding motorcycles and other vehicles stormed the mining site early in the morning.
